entry.title: Taskipelago v1.2.0
entry.content:
*The big region overhaul (and also clicker game mode)*
## What's new * New types of item grouping definitions. Now progressive, aesthetic, or random-choice * aesthetic groups merely group things aesthetically with no effect on progression or not. * random-choice groups randomly choose N or N% as you define items from within the group to be included in the world. No tasks may depend on individual items in these groups since they aren't guaranteed to exist, but depending on the randomized group as a whole or by percentage/count is supported. * progressive groups function the same as always * Regions can now also be randomized to include N or N% of tasks within that region. May optionally also shuffle the order in which such tasks appear. * Subregions can now be defined within regions that aren't randomized (subregions may be randomized). * Regions may now depend on items and tasks via the syntax item(expr) and task(expr) where expr is any valid task or item dependency expression * Tasclickpelago toggle on the yaml generator that enables a bunch of features for building out an idle game because the concept was funny and I thought of a way to do it well. * Style tab added to the YAML generator so you can recolor the entire application at will while connected to the slot in question. Pretty colors are pretty. * Added syntax `item(...) and task(...)` to reference an item or task from within task prereqs and item prereqs fields respectively. This also works in the goal requirements, so you can now depend on receiving items to goal. The other benefit here is using OR operators on tasks and items together allowing for some interesting new logic. * Added a setting for filler items to grant a hint/scout for a random item (See the hint/scout dropdown). * Fix browser choice to use user's default where possible and never prefer Edge otherwise * Fix OR not working properly with region dependencies
Note: should be fully backwards compatible with worlds generated from 1.0 onwards. Also Universal Tracker is still incompatible.

entry.title: Crab Champions v1.4.0
entry.content:
## Highlights
Every weapon, melee weapon and ability can now go in the pool, only pool equipment counts toward your goal, and received perks and mods are applied as whole stacks.
**Compatible with 1.3 seeds.** Update the apworld and the mod together.
## Changes
### Full equipment pools `weapons_in_pool`, `melee_in_pool` and `abilities_in_pool` now go up to 20, 5 and 7, which puts every item of that kind in the pool. When a pool is full you start with one random item from it, so you always have something to use. `starting_weapons` is forced to at least 1 when `weapons_in_pool` is 20.
### Completion only counts pool equipment Equipment you have from the start no longer counts toward `weapons_for_completion`, `melee_for_completion` or `ability_for_completion`. With `equipment_check_mode` set to `regular` or `filler_only`, the goal could previously be finished without receiving a single AP item. Runs with non-pool equipment are still location checks under `equipment_check_mode`, they just don't advance the goal.
Seeds made with 1.3 keep the old rule, so updating mid-seed won't change your goal.
### Starting equipment isn't duplicated Equipment you start with is no longer also placed in the item pool. That slot goes to filler instead of a second copy of something you already have.
### `guaranteed_items` copy counts Counts are now honored for perks and mods, so `Time Bolt: 2` gives two copies. Relics and equipment are unique and still get one.
## Bug Fixes
- Received perks and mods are now applied as one stack per item. Duplicates that arrived after your inventory filled up no longer get stuck behind other items, and items you already have still stack when the inventory is full. - Fixed reconnecting mid-session leaving stale state behind, which could grant pending crystals twice or stop overflowed items from retrying. - The mod now refuses to connect to a seed made for a different major version instead of sending checks for the wrong locations, and the overlay says why.
## For Developers
- F9 writes a full pickup dump (`pickup_dump_<time>.txt`) with every item's rarity, loot pool and tag, and flags new and greed items. - `tools/check_sync.py` checks the Lua client's item tables against the apworld.
## Download
- Archipelago world: `crabchampions.apworld` → place in your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory - In-game mod: `CrabChampionsAP.zip` → extract into your Crab Champions `Mods/` directory (UE4SS required)

entry.title: Turok 2 v0.6.0
entry.content:
Alpha of the Turok 2 Randomizer with [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/) support. Expect general instability.
**[Non-Windows needs additional setup](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1238135254947074129/1544566143203676180)**. _There's no doc page for it at the moment._
_(optional)_ [Poptracker pack.](https://github.com/chikakoo/Turok-2-Poptracker/releases/tag/v1.0.0) _(optional)_ [Hue shifter script (version agnostic)](https://github.com/chikakoo/Turok-2-Randomizer/blob/main/hue_shifter.py). [_Read about it here!_](https://github.com/chikakoo/Turok-2-AP-World/blob/main/worlds/turok2/docs/hue_shifter.md) See the [documentation](https://github.com/chikakoo/Turok-2-AP-World/tree/main/worlds/turok2/docs) for more details _(including the setup guide and changelog)_! Link to the [randomizer repo](https://github.com/chikakoo/Turok-2-Randomizer) for reference.
**Expected mod version is 0.6.0.**
- Background changes to support the poptracker and auto tabbing - Support yamless for Universal Tracker - Starting inventory is now received from the AP server - Added a generate_for_offline setting if you don't want to connect to AP (you'll get the starting inventory like before) - Fixed a couple item classifications and non-breaking logic bugs - Various location name fixes/adjustments - Combined various item weight settings for clarity and simplicity - Added seed validation to prevent playing with the wrong save. This handles: - Loading a save file from a different patch file than it was saved with - Loading a save file for the incorrect slot/multiworld - Error fixes found by the fuzzer: - Generation failure when starting with every weapon with force_early_weapon on - Generation failure when level unlock method is one_progressive_warp with starting_progressive_warps set to 0 - Unit test failure caused by adding to local_items after generate_early - Attempted fix for very rare, hard to reproduce enemizer(?) crash - Updated the hue_shifter.py script - Hue now goes up to 180, and rolls a value from -X to X - Brightness/saturation can now go up to 1000%, if you want to be that insane - Added a GROUPS property with some defaults to prevent annoying flashing textures
**tl;dr setup (see the guide for details):** 1. Install the AP world. 2. Download the mod, unzip into the "mods" folder of your Turok 2 install (create it if it doesn't exist; overwrite all existing files). 3. Generate the seed. 4. Get your patch file, **unzip it**, and place **rando.kpf** into the mods folder as well. 5. You're good to go! If solo, no need to run AP. Otherwise, you can connect the client and open the game in any order.

# Funi Raccoon Game Archipelago v1.8.0 *What kind of QoL update has as many lines as a content update...?*
`New:` - Completely reworked how the mod loads itself and builds itself. This does mean there is a completely new process for setting up the mod. Please refer to the setup guide. - Added an in game tracker menu, built into the settings menu on the "AP" tab. This also displays some information about the Archipelago slot, and your goals. - Added an Archipelago logo icon to held items on the UI, to show if you have sent the check for them or not. - Added an option to mute the monitor sound in the audio settings. - Added more info to the vanilla game tracker popup about euros/cats. - Added object ids to the CHEESE in the trasco train. - Added a hat selector menu into Photoautomat in the dumpster, usable after you hit your act 2 threshold! - Added a 1/4 chance for the funi marketable plushie spawner in The Process to spawn a beenie the birthday boy.
`Changes:` - Removed kei truck dumpster weight blocking as an option. This is now forcefully on, so the kei truck cannot store things that would've been too heavy for you to hold. This simplifies logic a bit. - Changed the function key settings to be a proper checkbox setting on the AP tab in the settings menu. - Changed `F1` to quick open the AP tab in the settings menu. - Changed the objective list to properly check off items collected by Collect - Changed logic for a few items that are accessible in a few other places. - Changed multiple maps to include multiple items that were missing in their vanilla in game tracker. - Changed euro items to use the in game euro popup when receiving them. - Changed Rackheath to not display the tutorial and intro cutscene every single time you enter it, only showing it the first time. Also adjusted the pause menu to allow for going straight to the dumpster. - Changed the hat store to not require you to buy obtained hats. - Renamed the "Checks Sent" in the level select orb and objective list to "Dumpster Items Sent" to make it clearer what the counter is. - Removed the requirement to be sent Orb in order to open the Orb store, as it doesn't line up with how every other shop works in the game - Changed the vanilla game item tracker popup to always display items sprites fully instead of showing black shades, to make it easier to use. - Moved the connection info text a bit higher and made it wavy to match the UI better. - Changed the mystical jewel items into "Progressive Mystical Jewels" to make it easier to understand.
`Fixes:` - Fixed a minor id bug with a few brazil items and hintblo on the apworld end. - Fixed boingler requiring Pickaxe when it does not. - Fixed kei truck being removed from hand making your character show as holding nothing - Fixed a few kei truck bypass exploits - Fixed the game hard crashing after the Blimbo Village race sequence. - Fixed (if you can call it a fix) the vanilla game adding PURGATORY to found levels early, and Cricket having a 1% chance from a fish vore door, making it impossible to use Fish Vore to enter these levels early. - Fixed Kei Truck Radio sometimes being removed from the generation.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.3
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Just reload the page.** No new seed, no new yaml, no re-download. The APworld is identical to 1.8.2 apart from its version number. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Angels no longer crash the game
An Angel froze the game as soon as a thrown ring landed. Gold per Thrown Ring defaults to 50, so this hit every seed with an Angel in it.
Stick Ranger checks that your gold still matches what it last recorded, and destroys the game window if it does not. Every other place that moves gold tells it to record the new value. The ring payout, added in 1.8.0, did not — so the next check saw gold it had not agreed to and killed the window.
Thanks to everyone who reported it.
## Also fixed
- The -50% gold trap changed your gold without going through the one place Ring Link watches, so a trap taking half your money broadcast nothing to the room. - With Ring Link off, the running total of unsent gold was never emptied and grew for the whole session.
## Changes
### Client
- Every gold movement is now checked against the anti-cheat by a test, at every place in the game that moves gold, so this cannot come back at a new one. - A second test asserts nothing moves gold behind Ring Link's back.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.4
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Just reload the page.** No new seed, no new yaml, no re-download. The APworld is identical to 1.8.3 apart from its version number. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Rangers walking off on their own
A ranger would sometimes wander towards enemies while still attacking, most visibly a Sniper strolling into melee. It was a movement key stuck on.
Only the selected ranger responds to the walk keys, and that walk runs independently of attacking, so a stuck key is the one thing that makes a ranger walk and shoot at the same time. Three ways it got stuck, all fixed:
- Releasing `a` or `d` while holding Shift cleared the wrong key and left the original held for good. - A key held while the window lost focus never got a release at all, so alt-tabbing mid-walk left the ranger walking. - Anything typed into the Archipelago chat box also reached the game, so chatting a word with an `a` or `d` in it walked whoever was selected.
## Shop checks
- Shop cells now show the Archipelago logo. The logo is a separate image and the shop was looking for it in the item sheet, where it does not exist, so the cell came out blank. - The Shop Hints line no longer overlaps. It sat four pixels above the stat rows and ran sideways over the item grid; it now wraps into the space the stats used to take. - An uncollected check no longer lists the weapon's AT, AGI and Range. Buying it sends a check rather than the weapon, so those numbers never described what you were buying. They come back once the check is collected and the cell sells the real item again.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.5
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Regenerate your yaml.** Progressive Shop is now four separate items and there is a new option below. - **A seed already in progress keeps working**, but it keeps the old shop behaviour: one shared Progressive Shop item and no logic on the shop rows. Only a new seed gets any of this. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## The shop was not in logic at all
With Progressive Shop off, shop checks had no requirement beyond walking into the town. The game only stocks a row once you have beaten a stage that sells it, so Archipelago was free to put a stage unlock thirty rows deep and call it reachable from the start.
Shop rows now sit behind the same progress the game asks for:
- rows 0-8 need nothing - rows 9-13 need Castle - rows 14-17 need Submarine Shrine - rows 18-22 need Pyramid - rows 23-32 need Ice Castle
Those come from the game's own stock table, not from a number picked here.
The effect on a Shop Checks seed: with every Progressive Shop item and no world progress, the number of shop checks Archipelago considers reachable drops from all 462 to 145. That is what stops a seed handing out nothing but Progressive Shop while you wait for it to cough up a stage.
## A progressive track per shop
Progressive Shop was one item that opened all four shops at once. Each shop now has its own:
- **Progressive Town Shop** x32 - **Progressive Village Shop** x15 - **Progressive Resort Shop** x9 - **Progressive Island Shop** x33
Town keeps its first row stocked, because that is where you start. Village, Resort and Island hold nothing at all until their first item arrives, and say **No items in stock** rather than showing an empty grid.
## New option
- **Enforce Shop Logic** — a shop row Archipelago does not consider reachable yet is greyed out and cannot be bought. This is the shop's half of Enforce Logic. Leave it off and the shop still sells anything it has stocked; logic simply does not count on you buying it.
## Also fixed
- Shop hints are coloured by what the item is, the same as the message log. - Book hints were coloured by comparing the whole classification against one value at a time, so an item that was both progression and useful came out white. Books, the shop and the message log now share one table.

## Village, Resort and Island never opened
With Progressive Shop on, Village, Resort and Island said **No items in stock** however many of their Progressive items you held.
1.8.5 gave each shop its own item, but when one arrived the client only recorded Town's. A shop's stock is counted from what the client has recorded, so the other three shops stayed at zero for good.
Every shop's item is recorded now. The items you already hold were never written down, so reconnecting once picks them up as new and the shop opens to where it should be.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.7
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Just reload the page.** No new seed, no new yaml, no re-download. The APworld is identical to 1.8.6 apart from its version number. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Ring Link died the moment both players had been in a shop
Ring Link worked for a few minutes, then went silent for good. No error, no message, gold simply stopped crossing.
Every client tags its own packets with an id so the server's echo of its own gold can be ignored. Walking out of a shop wiped that id, because a copy of the connect-time setup had ended up in the shop-exit branch. Both players then sent packets with no id, and every client compared an empty id against its own empty id and threw the other player's gold away as its own echo.
It needed both players to have visited a shop, which is why it always worked at first. This has been broken since Ring Link shipped in 1.8.0.
An id is never reused or left empty now, nothing goes out without one, and an empty id can no longer match anything.
## Ring Link could also stop sending on a long session
The outgoing batch was the last step of the client's tick, behind four saves and two location sends. If any of those was slow the batch did not run at all, and saves get slower the longer you play. It now runs on its own, and the five second window is only spent when something is actually sent.
## Ring Link counters
`window.ArchipelagoMod.ringLinkStats` in the browser console now reports what was sent, what was received, and every reason a packet was dropped or a send skipped. If the link ever goes quiet again, that says why in one line instead of an evening of guessing.

Held 1st on Cortex Castle and Hot Air Skyway needs Ultimate Sacred Fire. - **Easy and medium:** with Itemsanity off, Trophy Races on the harder tracks now need your first boost. - **Skip Cutscenes:** new local option under Options > Gameplay. - **Discord Status:** new local option under Options > Archipelago, off by default. Shows your track, mode, check count and race clock; no room, slot or seed details. - **Freezes:** the one-second freezes while racing are fixed. Short pauses on screen changes remain. - **Steam Deck:** Fullscreen no longer lags. - **Cutscenes:** the boss door scene plays once per hub and the Oxide Final Challenge scene once per seed. - **Fresh rooms:** traps and Wumpa from an old room of the same seed no longer carry over. - **Traps:** Flatten waits for a race instead of firing in the hub, and a Mask no longer drops queued traps. - **Title screen:** Archipelago colours on the ring and an ARCHIPELAGO line. - **Signed downloads:** `manifest.json` and its minisign signature let you check the client archives.
## Downloads
Get `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.2-windows-x86.zip` for Windows or `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.2-linux-x86.tar.gz` for Linux and Steam Deck (glibc 2.36 or newer). Each has the client and the matching `ctr.apworld`. A 0.2.1 room can be played on the 0.2.2 client; for new seeds use the 0.2.2 client and APWorld together. Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer is needed to host. The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are for hosts and generators. The `.sha256` files check your downloads, `manifest.json` and `manifest.json.minisig` are the signed manifest (how to check it is in the full notes), and the `.debug` files help with crash reports; you don't need them to play. You need your own NTSC-U disc; no game data is included. The client isn't code-signed.
Known issues: short pauses on screen changes and low frame rate in Gem Stone Valley ([#376](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/376)), large reconnect backlogs can stall the game ([#147](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/147)), and some podium characters can show up invisible ([#282](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/282)). The final Linux build passed its automated checks; earlier 0.2.2 test builds ran on the Steam Deck.

| Asset | SHA-256 | |---|---| | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.2-windows-x86.zip` | `df6c5fac4d5c823a71374de322e43536514fdf91d3e614f2d396a8bd142adc9b` | | `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.2-linux-x86.tar.gz` | `e52a20500152350aaa038b674aee0060fa4acd19e3f8f6878923fd9424c5f511` | | `ctr.apworld` | `f939d2dd02e5b84261a1fb683ad786a2b9921eae1f0ce6d1dfabe45e729a0a0c` | | `manifest.json` | `9e94cd5afaba7e1cdbecca8f51d3826dc483ec5568d4c06647211d527a13f2a0` |
## Reporting a problem
[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) with your client version, platform, seed or YAML and what happened. Include the support bundle when it helps: run `support-bundle.bat` on Windows or `support-bundle.sh` on Linux and check it before attaching; it doesn't upload anything by itself. Questions are welcome in the [Crash Team Racing channel](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1222304293751750777) on the Archipelago Discord.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.8
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Just reload the page.** No new seed, no new yaml, no re-download. The APworld is identical to 1.8.7 apart from its version number. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Village, Resort and Island were empty on an older seed
With Progressive Shop on, a seed generated before 1.8.5 showed nothing in the Village, Resort and Island shops however many Progressive Shop items you held. Town was fine, so it did not look like a total failure.
Those seeds send a single Progressive Shop item covering all four shops. 1.8.5 gave each shop its own item and started counting them one shop at a time, and an older seed has nothing to count for three of the four. That one shared count now opens every shop again, which is what it always did.
A seed made with 1.8.5 or later was never affected, and still gets a track per shop.
## New option
- **Important Hints Only** — the shop and the Book shop only hint the room about progression and trap items, and stay quiet about filler and useful ones. You still see everything yourself. A seed with Shop Checks has 462 shop items, and hinting all of them buries every other player's hints.

entry.content:
# What's New? - Joined all three separate berry settings into a single **Berrysanity** setting - Added Black Berries to the **Berrysanity** setting - Added a new **Companionsanity** setting for Companions, except for Dora and Lineth - Added a new **Lunar Crystal Branch Shuffle** setting to add Lunar Crystal Branches (those things that give you money when destroyed) as item location checks - Added custom in-game notifications when sending or receiving items
# What Changed? ## YAML Stuff - Upadted naming convention for Progressive Damage Upgrade (**Lilysanity**), Progressive Lumen Fairies (**Fairysanity**), Progressive Final Boss Key (**Selin Door Keysanity**) (I like the Sanity naming convention)
## World Stuff - **Open Springleaf Path** setting now only affects areas that connect Springleaf Path within itself or with other areas, and no longer removes Demon Strings in the entire world. This means that items that previously had their Demon Strings removed with this setting on, even if they were in Springleaf Path, will now have their Demon Strings at all times, requiring the need for the Awakened Sacred Leaf to get them. The only affected item in Springleaf Path is the Lun Berry, which you can still get in other ways - Updated rules in world generation to try to match mostly vanilla stuff (or **Bell Hover Generation** if enabled) needed to access certain areas/items
## Game Stuff - Changed the amount of Lunar Crystals you receive on filler, from 100 to 10. This was so money generating companions or The Profiteer Sigil can be more important - Removed the green bubbles in Lun Tree Roots that appear after clearing Fairy Springs. I did this in order to have Lun Tree Roots more open in case you don't have some skills that could be needed to traverse Lun Tree Roots in that state - Connection attempts now happen when entering a save file. At least now if you forget to modify your config.json file you don't need to close and reopen the game, you can quit to menu and open your save file. Note that this still doesn't work properly in case of disconnect, you still need to close and reopen the game (networking stuff is hard I'm sorry) - Fixed connection stuff (I hope it remains this way), now the game won't freeze when sending an item, and it overall runs better than before

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.9
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Regenerate your yaml** for the two new options below. - **A game already in progress keeps working** and does not need a new seed. Everything here except the two options is on the website, so reload and carry on. - Shop checks are named for their town now, so a new seed reads "Island Shop: Guide Card 1" rather than "Shop: Guide Card 1". A seed already running keeps the names it was made with. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Your game was not being saved
Saving only happened when something crossed the network: a check sent, an item received, a shop scouted. Play a run of stages with none of those and nothing was ever written, so a refresh threw away every level, item and coin earned since the last one.
Leaving a stage, or moving to a different one, now saves as well.
## New options
- **Trap Disguise** — a trap waiting in a shop or a book wears the name of some other item in the room, misspelled: "Unlock Laek", "Progressive Eisland Shoppe", "Mothwing Cloack". It reads as a real item at a glance and gives itself away only if you look properly. Only you are fooled; anyone else scouting that location still sees the trap for what it is. - **Removable Compos** — a compo already fitted to a weapon can be taken back out by clicking its slot with an empty hand. In the base game a compo is in for good once fitted, so a good one sunk into a starter weapon is gone. The cross blocking a store-bought slot stays where it is.
## The shop
- A shop check holding a Stick Ranger item now shows that item rather than the Archipelago logo, so a shelf reads at a glance. It works for any Stick Ranger player's item, not only your own. - A check holding a Progressive Shop item wears its own Archipelago tile with an arrow, so you can pick those out without reading. - A row that opens while you are standing in the shop is scouted straight away. It used to show a logo with nothing behind it until you walked out and back in. - Shop checks are named for their town: "Island Shop: Guide Card 1".
## Also
- Every ring an Angel throws floats its payout over the angel's head, the same yellow number a gold pickup gives you. Nothing floats up once you are at the gold cap, because nothing is landing.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.11
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Regenerate your yaml** for the new book cost mode below. - **A game already in progress keeps working.** Every fix here is on the website, so reload and carry on. The Resort shop change only takes effect in a new seed. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Trap Disguise did nothing, and took shop text with it
Building a disguise read a list the client does not have, which threw partway through handling a batch of scouted locations. The trap came through undisguised and every location behind it in that batch lost its text, which is why shop checks kept showing a logo with nothing written under it.
Both are fixed. Disguises now work, and one bad hint can no longer silence the rest.
## Towns were not saved
Leaving a stage saved; leaving a town did not. Gold spent, items bought and levels respecced at the forget tree lasted only until the next refresh.
## !hint stage and !hint class
Two new chat commands. They ask the seed's own logic what the next locked gate is still short of and hint it for you.
You can see that Castle will not open. You cannot see which Grassland stage counts towards it, or how many classes it still wants. These do.
## The Resort shop
Resort sells each weapon twice in the same column: cheap with its compo slot blocked, and ten times the price with it open. Both are the same catalogue item, so both were the same check, and buying either quietly settled the other. The check now sits on the first of the pair only.
Its grid also shows both rows from the start, so the shop has one stock level rather than nine. A new seed puts one **Progressive Resort Shop** in the pool instead of nine, eight of which opened nothing.
## Book costs, divided by ten
`randomize_book_costs` takes a new value, **vanilla_tenth**: the vanilla price of every book divided by ten.
## Opening the site from the room page
The room page links each player's name as an `archipelago://` address, which until now only offered the Text Client. A launcher component turns it into the website with host, port and slot name already filled in.
## Also
- Cavern 5's Green Shield Zombie is an uncommon drop, not a rare one.

Reverse Controls and ZVision traps can be active at the same time - **Improvement:** Optional granting of missable locations reworked. The Entrances tab now only appears when playing with ER - **Tweak:** The bottom of the well can now be exited by casting VOXAM - **Tweak:** Activating the Zork Rocks now starts the 10-second countdown right away - **Tweak:** The ZVision trap now uses a fisheye view instead of scrambling the screen - **Fix:** Addressed a vanilla totemizer crash due to a missing audio file - **Fix:** Goal completion is no longer sent to the server repeatedly - **Fix:** _I Spit on Your Filthy Coinage_, _That's Still a Rope_ and _Your Puny Weapons Don't Phase Me, Baby!_ no longer trigger without fully performing the action - **Fix:** Addressed an issue where _Make Love, Not War_, _Death: Old Age_ and _Death: Expressly Forbidden_ were only in logic from one side - **Fix:** VOXAM can no longer remain in a stuck state - **Fix:** Removed items can no longer briefly reappear in the inventory - **Fix:** Addressed a rare issue where scroll fragments could end up incorrectly mirrored - **Fix:** Leaving Hades through ER or VOXAM now always correctly clears active SNAVIG casts - **Fix:** The Port Foozle propaganda lines no longer follow you to other starting locations - **Fix:** The Old Scratch card death now has its own death link message - **Fix:** Addressed an issue where connecting would fail when running the client with `--nogui` _YAML changes:_ - _New options: Shuffle Time Tunnels and In-Game Overlay_ - _Artifacts of Magic Total and Required now go up to 20 (defaults are now 20 and 15)_ - _Deaths Required now goes up to 31 and Landmarks Required up to 23_ - _Starting Location now defaults to random_ A new version of ScummVM is required. entry.title: Final Fantasy VIII v0.8.0
entry.content:
## Install
1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher. 2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder. 3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.
### Visual Tracker
`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:
1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher. 2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it. 3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.
Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!
Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).

entry.title: Half-Life (Sven Co-op) v0.1.0r2
entry.content:
Note that this is an early build of the apworld. Please report any problems in Discord or the Issues page on github (with reproduction steps please and thank you!)
Sven Co-op's Half-Life campaign is meant to be played in multiplayer. No support will be offered to players attempting to circumvent this restriction. (The map "Suspension" is an exception to this rule)
**Important**: Run /install to update the plugin after you update your apworld.
## New Features * !menu GUI added * Melee Throw can now be added to the item pool, allowing you to throw the crowbar, knife, and umbrella via right click. * Bot Swarm Trap * PCV and Security Armor are now randomized separate from the HEV suit * Flashlight can now be randomized * Xen Healing pools added to chargesanity * Locations not present in a seed no longer display in game * When LJM is unshuffled, it now sits at its vanilla location rather than being always active
## Bug Fixes/Improvements * Various stability and consistency patches * Fixed an edge case crash related to pre-cacheing
## Setup As the game host: Install the apworld by downloading and double clicking (or placing it in your custom_worlds folder) Open the Half-Life (Sven Co-op) Client and select your install directory Run /install in the client Connect the client to the multiworld, and open a server on the map -sp_campaign_lobby Once your friends are in game with you (they can just join!), you can type !ap to see unlocked missions in the console, and !warp to change maps to the unlocked mission. (The lobby's mission panels also work). In addition, !menu opens an interface to warp, return to hub, find the nearest check, track remaining checks in a map, or locate a specific check.
## Known Issues * Sound cacheing bug: sometimes when another player joins the lobby, their sounds are all mixed up. This will self resolve once you get into a mission. I am under the impression that if they install the plugin too that helps, but either way, loading a new map should fix the issue.
